# Health.md

> Health.md moves Apple Health and Health Connect data into local files, scripts, and bounded agent workflows without requiring a Health.md health-data cloud.

This is a curated discovery aid for language-model clients. `llms.txt` is an emerging convention, not a web standard. The linked HTML documentation and versioned contracts remain authoritative. Documentation pages also publish an exact source Markdown alternate at `index.md` beneath the page URL (for example, `/docs/mcp/index.md`).

## Start here

- [Connect an agent in 10 minutes](https://healthmd.app/docs/guides/connect-agent/): released Health.md for Mac setup, iPhone connection, Codex or Claude configuration, explicit refresh, first bounded query, completeness checks, and timeout recovery.
- [Configure your agent](https://healthmd.app/docs/configuration/): interface selection and complete host configuration.
- [MCP server and tools](https://healthmd.app/docs/mcp/): released Mac tools and clearly marked portable preview.
- [Health.md CLI](https://healthmd.app/docs/cli/): bundled Mac CLI and portable-preview boundaries.
- [Typed query cookbook](https://healthmd.app/docs/agent-queries/): metric, sleep, workout, coverage, comparison, and evidence workflows.

## Trust, privacy, and source

- [Local-agent architecture and reporting rules](https://healthmd.app/docs/agents/)
- [Privacy policy](https://healthmd.app/privacy-policy.html)
- [Source repository](https://github.com/CodyBontecou/health-md)

Health.md reports factual observations with units, scope, coverage, missingness, evidence, and limitations. It does not diagnose, recommend treatment, or infer causation.
